camel_example: aliyun vod UpdateWatermark --region cn-hangzhou --WatermarkId af2afe4761992c00000bd947dae97337 --WatermarkConfig 'Width_:_55_,_Height_:_55_,_Dx_:_9_,_Dy_:_9_,_ReferPos_:_BottomLeft' --Name test
description_en: Modifies the name and configurations of a watermark template after you create a watermark template
description_zh: 添加图文水印模板后，可以调用本接口修改图文水印模板的模板名称和水印配置（WatermarkConfig）
kebab_example: aliyun vod update-watermark --name test --watermark-id af2afe4761992c00000bd947dae97337 --watermark-config Width_:_55_,_Height_:_55_,_Dx_:_9_,_Dy_:_9_,_ReferPos_:_BottomLeft --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWatermark

parameters.description_en:
The name of the watermark template to which you want to change.

*   Only letters and digits are supported.
*   The name cannot exceed 128 bytes.
*   The value must be encoded in UTF-8.
parameters.description_zh:
修改的水印模板名称。
- 只支持中英文、数字。
- 长度不超过128个字节。
- UTF-8编码。

parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the watermark template. You can specify only one watermark template ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:

*   Obtain the watermark template ID from the response to the [AddWatermark](~~AddWatermark~~) operation that you call to create a watermark template.
*   Obtain the watermark template ID from the response to the [ListWatermark](~~ListWatermark~~) operation that you call to query all watermark templates within your account.
parameters.description_zh:
需要修改的图文水印模板ID，仅支持传入单个水印模板ID。可通过如下方式获取：
- 调用[AddWatermark](~~AddWatermark~~)接口添加图文水印模板后会返回。
- 调用[ListWatermark](~~ListWatermark~~)接口查询图文水印模板列表后会返回。

parameters.description_en: The configuration information of the watermark such as the display position and special effects. The value must be a JSON string. The configuration parameters for image and text watermarks are different. For more information about the parameter structure, see [WatermarkConfig](~~98618#section-h01-44s-2lr~~).
parameters.description_zh:
图文水印的配置信息（JSON字符串），包括水印显示位置、水印效果等配置。图片水印和文字水印的配置参数不同，参数结构详情，请参见[WatermarkConfig](~~98618#section-h01-44s-2lr~~) 。
>暂不支持跨模板类型修改，您可以调用[GetWatermark](~~GetWatermark~~)接口查询水印模板所属类型后，再进行修改配置。
